violations.description: Plumbing system. — --Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation 3 compartment sink has drain leak and needs repair.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floors have build up of food debris and needs cleaning.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Back storage room has exposed studs.
General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Maintain seal on bare-wood shelving surfaces.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Exposed studs, joists or rafters were not covered with smooth, nonabsorbent and easily cleanable material. Wall construction not complete in back storage room.

Storage and handling of maintenance items. — --Wet-use maintenance items, such as mops, were not placed in a position that allows proper air-drying. Hang or place wet mops in a manner that allows air drying.
